00-todolist — the app is a module dir, like every rut program: the
manifest carries the deps, and the embedder (`src/main.rs`,
`tests/session.rs`) loads this dir through the manifest lane
(`load_dir_session_with`) — same host half, new mount lane.

THE CDN ROW: `pouch` ships as a COMMITTED v7 compiled bundle
(dist/std/pouch.rutbundle, jsDelivr-served at the tag, sha256-pinned
here — the pin is law at the mount door on every load). pouch is a
GENERIC owner, and since the generic-source riding law its bundle
carries the source beside the binary: this app's consumer-spelled
`Vec<Todo>` compiles from the bundle at the link. The embedder names
its remote policy (Loader + HttpRemote::project_local) — a cold start
networks on the miss, a warm start is pure cache; the TESTS prime an
offline remote from the committed artifacts (dist/std plays the
wire), so the gates never touch the network.
name: todolist
